title: 😱 Nisha's git reset erased a day of work... the reflog that undoes it #git #reflog
title_alts: 🧭 Nisha's git reflog lists every branch move... the log nobody opens #git #recovery
😬 Nisha nearly recloned her repo... the reset mistake reflog prevents #git #reflog
description_hook: A hard reset looks final. Git keeps a private record of every move your branch made, and it is one command away.
setting: a home desk with a laptop and a terminal window

characters.name: Nisha
characters.description: late twenties, shoulder-length black hair tied back, grey hooded sweatshirt, a chipped enamel mug always at her right hand

claims.basis: round illustrative assumption, stated as an example of one developer's log length

claims.claim: unreachable entries expire after about ninety days
claims.basis: git's documented default expiry window for unreachable reflog entries; configurable per repository
round illustrative number, chosen only to describe what the first screen of output shows

scenes.narration: Nisha ran reset --hard. A day of work vanished.
scenes.caption: निशा ने reset --hard चलाया और दिन भर का काम गायब हो गया।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a wooden desk in a dim room, a terminal window open with the command git reset --hard on the last line, the file list beside it nearly empty, cold blue screen light, a chipped enamel mug next to the keyboard.

scenes.narration: The editor's undo history was gone too. Nothing left on disk.
scenes.caption: ऐडिटर की अनडू हिस्ट्री भी गई। डिस्क पर कुछ नहीं बचा।
scenes.image_brief: The same laptop screen showing a code editor with an empty file and a greyed out undo menu, a cold cup of tea beside the keyboard, one desk lamp lighting the wooden desk, the rest of the room dark.

scenes.narration: Most people reclone the repo and rewrite everything by hand.
scenes.caption: ज़्यादातर लोग रिपो दोबारा क्लोन कर सब हाथ से लिखते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A monitor split between a repository clone page and an empty text file, a paper notebook of handwritten notes propped open beside the keyboard, harsh overhead office light, a cold mug pushed aside.

scenes.narration: Those commits are still there. Git keeps a private log.
scenes.caption: वे कमिट अब भी मौजूद हैं। Git अपना निजी लॉग रखता है।
scenes.image_brief: A terminal window filled with a list of short commit hashes, each line describing where a branch pointer moved, warm desk lamp light falling across the keyboard and the enamel mug.

scenes.narration: Every time your branch tip moves, Git writes the old position down.
scenes.caption: ब्रांच का सिरा हिलते ही Git पुरानी जगह लिख लेता है।
scenes.image_brief: A monitor showing a row of commit dots along a line, with a branch pointer arrow at one dot and every previous position copied into a numbered list at the side, soft even room light.

scenes.narration: That list is the reflog. It survives resets and bad checkouts.
scenes.caption: उस सूची को reflog कहते हैं। यह रीसेट के बाद भी बचती है।
scenes.image_brief: A monitor showing two panels side by side, the left one a short branch list after a reset, the right one a longer reflog list still holding the older entries, calm blue screen light in a dim room.

scenes.narration: Nisha typed git reflog and saw forty entries.
scenes.caption: निशा ने git reflog चलाया और चालीस ऐंट्री दिखीं।
scenes.image_brief: A terminal showing the output of git reflog, dozens of numbered entries scrolling up the screen, a desk with the enamel mug and a notepad beside the laptop, warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: Two lines up sat her commit. She checked it out into a new branch.
scenes.caption: दो लाइन ऐसे उसका कमिट था। उसने नई ब्रांच में चेकआउट किया।
scenes.image_brief: A terminal where one reflog line is highlighted and a new branch is being created from it, a short success message underneath, bright morning light coming through a window onto the wooden desk.

scenes.narration: One limit. Reflog only records commits.
scenes.caption: एक सीमा है। reflog सिर्य़ कमिट रिकॉर्ड करता है।
scenes.image_brief: A monitor showing a tidy list of committed changes on one side and a stack of unsaved editor tabs greyed out on the other, a dim room lit by a single desk lamp.

scenes.narration: Edits you never committed are gone. Unreachable entries expire after about ninety days.
scenes.caption: जो बदलाव कमिट नहीं हुए वे गए। बाकी करीब नब्बे दिन में मिटते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A monitor showing a git cleanup message about expiring unreachable objects, a paper wall calendar hanging beside the desk with many days crossed off, quiet grey daylight.

scenes.narration: So the fear is misplaced. Losing a commit is nearly impossible.
scenes.caption: तो डर बेकार है। कमिट खोना लगभग नामुमकिन है।
scenes.image_brief: A tidy wooden desk with a laptop showing a clean branch list and the recovered file open in an editor, the enamel mug steaming, warm morning light across the keyboard.

scenes.narration: Committing often is what makes reflog work.
scenes.caption: बार-बार कमिट करना ही reflog को काम का बनाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A monitor showing a long dense commit history, dozens of small entries listed one after another with short messages, soft daylight from a side window onto the desk.

scenes.narration: Run git reflog now. See your last ten moves.
scenes.caption: अभी git reflog चलाएँ। अपने पिछले दस कदम देखें।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop terminal at a fresh prompt with the words git reflog typed and a blinking cursor, the screen the only light in a dark room, the enamel mug in shadow beside it.

title: 😬 Tejas builds green on his laptop only... the lockfile CI needs #npm #lockfile
title_alts: 🔒 Tejas's lockfile pins every package version... the file CI reads #npm #ci
😖 Tejas ran npm install on the build server... the one word to change #npm #ci
description_hook: It works on my machine is not a joke, it is a versioning bug. Here is the file that decides which versions you actually get.
setting: a shared office desk and a build server dashboard
protagonist_type: a web developer pushing to a build pipeline

characters.name: Tejas
characters.description: early thirties, short cropped hair, plain navy t-shirt, wire-rimmed glasses pushed up on his forehead

claims.claim: like anything above one point two
claims.basis: round illustrative version range, used only to show how a range is written
round illustrative assumption about one developer's test run

scenes.narration: Tejas ships code that builds on his laptop only.
scenes.caption: तेजस का कोड सिर्य़ उसके लैपटॉप पर बनता है।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a shared office desk showing a green build message in a terminal, and behind it a wall monitor showing the same project failing in red, flat fluorescent ceiling light.

scenes.narration: The build server installs the same packages and fails immediately.
scenes.caption: बिल्ड सर्वर वही पैकेज इंस्टॉल करता है और तुरंत फेल हो जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A wall mounted dashboard showing a build log that stops on a red error line partway down the install step, an empty office chair in front of it, cool evening light through a window.

scenes.narration: Same package names. Quietly different versions underneath.
scenes.caption: पैकेज के नाम वही। अंदर वर्शन चुपचाप अलग।
scenes.image_brief: Two package lists shown side by side on one monitor, the names identical in both columns but the version numbers differing on several rows, the differences standing out in a plain table, even office light.

scenes.narration: By the end you will know which file decides those versions.
scenes.caption: अंत तक आप जान जाएँगे कि वर्शन कौन सी फ़ाइल तय करती है।
scenes.image_brief: A code editor showing a project folder tree with two files highlighted next to each other, a small manifest file and a much longer lock file, warm light from a desk lamp.

scenes.narration: package.json asks for a range, like anything above one point two.
scenes.caption: package.json एक रेंज माँगता है, जैसे 1.2 से ऊपर कुछ भी।
scenes.image_brief: A monitor showing a short manifest file where a dependency line carries a version range with a caret symbol, the rest of the file dimmed, quiet desk lamp light.

scenes.narration: Every install resolves that range on the day it runs.
scenes.caption: हर इंस्टॉल उस रेंज को उसी दिन के हिसाब से तय करता है।
scenes.image_brief: A terminal mid install, a progress line resolving a package name into one exact version number, a long list of resolved packages scrolling above it, cool screen light on a dark desk.

scenes.narration: Tejas installed his copy weeks earlier. The server picked up a newer patch.
scenes.caption: तेजस ने हफ़्ते पहले इंस्टॉल किया था। सर्वर को नया पैच मिला।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop and a wall dashboard in the same office, each showing the same dependency name but a different patch version resolved, a paper coffee cup on the desk, flat office light.

scenes.narration: That patch changed one default. Three of his tests failed.
scenes.caption: उस पैच ने एक डिफ़ॉल्ट बदला। उसके तीन टेस्ट फेल हो गए।
scenes.image_brief: A test results panel on a monitor showing a column of passing checks with three red failures grouped together near the bottom, the office otherwise dark except the screen.

scenes.narration: The lock file pins the exact versions. Commit it.
scenes.caption: लॉक फ़ाइल सही वर्शन पिन करती है। उसे कमिट करें।
scenes.image_brief: A monitor showing a lock file with exact version numbers on every line, and beside it a commit staging list with that lock file ticked, warm lamp light on a tidy desk.

scenes.narration: But plain npm install can rewrite that file. Use npm ci.
scenes.caption: लेकिन npm install उसे बदल सकता है। npm ci इस्तेमाल करें।
scenes.image_brief: A terminal showing two commands stacked on the same screen, the first followed by a modified file marker next to the lock file, the second followed by a clean unchanged file list, cool screen light.

scenes.narration: A green laptop proves nothing about the build server.
scenes.caption: लैपटॉप पर हरा निशान सर्वर के बारे में कुछ साबित नहीं करता।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop showing a green passing build sitting on a desk in the foreground, and a large wall screen behind it showing the same project still red, the two lights mixing in a dim office.

scenes.narration: Open your repo. Is the lock file committed?
scenes.caption: अपनी रिपो खोलें। क्या लॉक फ़ाइल कमिट हुई है?
scenes.image_brief: A file tree open on a monitor with the lock file selected and its version control status shown beside it, a mouse and a notebook on the desk, plain daylight from a window.
